    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.surjective_precomposition_of_finite_quotient_tests (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (M : ModuleCat R) (h : ∀ (Q : FGModuleCat R) (q : M ⟶ Q.obj), Function.Surjective ⇑(ModuleCat.Hom.hom q) → 0 ≤ (eulerWeight k P).eval Q) :
    Function.Surjective fun (f : ↑P.target →ₗ[R] ↑M) => f ∘ₗ ModuleCat.Hom.hom P.differential.hom

    A functional obstructing surjectivity is represented by a map to the finite Nakayama module. Its image is a finite quotient detecting the obstruction.
